name: OH- HOHOHOHO~!

boost.name: Dramatic Entrance
effect: Advance up to 2 spaces.
BEFORE: Name a card. Your opponent must reveal their hand and discard all copies of it.
description: 以Elizabeth的經典開場笑聲命名。這是全遊戲最高速的攻擊之一，體現她華麗登場、震懾全場的戲劇性氣場。附加的命名棄牌效果，象徵她的存在感讓對手不得不正視。

name: Ello Ello Ello~!

boost.name: Cockney Shibboleth
effect: +0-2 Range.
HIT: Draw a card.
AFTER: Move up to 2 spaces.
description: 致敬Elizabeth著名的Cockney腔問候（省略h音的'Ello'）。低攻高速的機動牌，命中後抽牌並可移動，猶如她切換RP與Cockney腔的語言切換能力一樣靈活自如。

name: The Queen's Speech

boost.name: Royal Decree
effect: +1 Guard for each card in your Gauge.
HIT: Gain 2 life and draw a card.
description: 靈感來自Elizabeth的聖誕傳統「Queen's Speech」。這張防禦型牌象徵她的女王氣場，命中後回復生命並抽牌，如同她在聖誕致詞中為子民帶來希望與力量。

name: Voice Mimicry

boost.name: Perfect Impression
effect: Look at your opponent's hand and name a card. They discard a copy of it if able.
HIT: Choose 1 card from your opponent's discard and add it to your hand.
description: 代表Elizabeth引以為傲的聲音模仿天賦。這張干擾牌能窺探對手手牌並強制棄牌，命中後更能複製對手棄牌區的卡片，體現她能完美模仿任何人的聲音，連身份都能偽裝。

name: Thorn of Justice

boost.name: Harbinger of Order
effect: Stun Immunity.
BEFORE: Close 1 space.
HIT: Push the opponent 2 spaces and gain Advantage (you take the next turn, regardless of who initiated the Strike).
description: 以Elizabeth的武器「Thorn（荊棘）」命名，這把刻有天秤鱗片的黑紅大劍象徵正義。強力近戰攻擊，推進壓制後取得先手權，展現她作為Justice領導者不可動搖的決心。

name: Blue Flame Waltz

boost.name: Crimson Afterglow
effect: At the start of each of the opponent's turns, +0-1 Range (max of +2).
Ignore Armor.
HIT: Retreat up to 2 spaces.
description: 代表Elizabeth胸前的藍色火焰標誌。遠程火焰攻擊無視防禦，命中後拉開距離，如同她優雅而致命的身法——藍色火焰在戰場上舞動，無人能擋。

name: Let My Voice Be Your Strength

boost.name: Encouraging Aria
effect: +1 Power for each card in hand you have more than the opponent.
HIT: Draw 2 cards.
AFTER: You may give 1 card from your hand to a teammate (if playing solo, gain 1 life instead).
description: 以Elizabeth的官方標語命名。此輔助牌體現她的歌聲能賦予他人力量的主題，手牌優勢轉化為攻擊力，抽牌效果象徵她的歌聲帶給人們勇氣與希望。

name: Royal Nap

boost.name: Comfy Bed
effect: At the start of each of your turns, gain 1 life.
BEFORE: Gain 3 life.
AFTER: Shuffle this card into your deck instead of discarding it.
description: 改編自官方設定中Elizabeth靠午睡恢復壓力的描述。純防禦牌，提供高額護甲與生命恢復，且會回到牌組繼續使用，如同她所說的「沒有什麼是一張舒適床上的午睡解決不了的」。

name: RENEGADE

boost.name: Rebel Heart
effect: Discard any number of cards from your hand. For each card discarded, +1 Power this Strike.
HIT: Gain Advantage (you take the next turn, regardless of who initiated the Strike).
AFTER: You may add 1 card from your discard to your Gauge.
description: 以Elizabeth的原創歌曲命名。高攻擊力的超絕技，可透過棄牌來提升威力，命中後回收資源，完美呼應歌曲中反抗束縛、追求自由的精神。

name: Scarlet Serendipity

boost.name: SUPERNOVA SUPER GIRL
effect: This card gains +0-2 Range and +1 Power for each card in your Gauge.
Ignore Armor and Guard.
HIT: Your opponent discards cards from the top of their deck equal to the damage dealt.
description: 結合Elizabeth的兩首2026年原創曲「Serendipity」與「SUPERNOVA SUPER GIRL」作為終極大招。最高消費的最強攻擊，無視所有防禦，造成傷害同時破壞對手牌組，如同她站在舞台上以歌聲震撼全場的壓倒性存在感。
